dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seen anyone who looks a lot like me?

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: Oh, so you're looking for family.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: While I know most anything about Mondstadt, I have to admit that this is one thing I'm not apprised of...

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: There's just been no time — too much on my plate, lately.

dialogues.speaker: Vile
dialogues.text: When I'm done settling those things, I'll help you look.
